novel_features.name: Structured market offers
novel_features.description: Current offers of your market (and next week's once REWE publishes them) as rows with title, price and category.
novel_features.rationale: Parses the offers page and stores it per ISO week for offline search.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Use it to answer what is on offer or to propose deals.

novel_features.name: Deals on my products
novel_features.description: Offers that match products you bought before or saved as favourites.
novel_features.rationale: Joins live offers with purchased products and favourites.

novel_features.name: Earliest pickup slot
novel_features.description: The earliest free pickup slot with its fee, optionally reserved right away.
novel_features.rationale: Filters the full slot list and calls the reservation endpoint with the basket's customer id.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Propose the earliest pickup before ordering.

novel_features.name: Full checkout with confirmation gate
novel_features.description: Place the pickup order: refresh basket, reserve slot, pay in market, submit - only with --confirm.
novel_features.rationale: Chains five web-shop steps that no other client exposes as one call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: The only command that spends money; agents must show the preview and get a yes first.

novel_features.name: Recipe to basket
novel_features.description: Map a REWE recipe's ingredients to shop products for N servings and add the recommended ones.
novel_features.rationale: Uses REWE's own ingredient mapper behind the recipe page's order button.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Recipe planning: pick recipes, get one basket.

novel_features.name: Basket by text
novel_features.description: Add products by search text and quantity without knowing listing ids.
novel_features.rationale: Resolves the basket id from the shop and the best product match from search.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Natural-language orders map straight onto this.

novel_features.name: Shopping list to basket
novel_features.description: Turn a shopping list (one item per line, optional quantity) into basket items.
novel_features.rationale: Batch search plus best-match selection plus one multi-add call.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Feed a transcribed voice note directly.

novel_features.name: Price history
novel_features.description: Price changes of a product seen in searches and offers over time.
novel_features.rationale: Local snapshots in SQLite; REWE shows only today's price.
novel_features.why_it_matters: Tell whether an offer is really cheap.

narrative.headline: Order REWE groceries for pickup from the terminal or an agent - offers, basket, earliest slot and recipes, with a session that renews itself.
narrative.value_prop: rewe-pp-cli replays the logged-in REWE web shop: search your market's catalogue, build the basket by text, pick the earliest pickup slot and place the order with pay-at-pickup behind an explicit --confirm. offers, deals mine and recipe basket turn the shop into a weekly planner.
narrative.auth_narrative: Log in once to rewe.de in a browser (REWE requires a captcha and two-factor login), then run rewe-pp-cli auth import --cdp http://127.0.0.1:9222 or --file cookies.json. The CLI keeps the shop session alive with REWE's 30-day single-sign-on cookie (auth renew, also done automatically) and says when a fresh browser login is needed.

quickstart.comment: find a pickup market near you

troubleshoots.fix: Log in to rewe.de in a browser again, then run rewe-pp-cli auth import
Wait a few minutes and retry; keep request volume low; re-import cookies to refresh cf_clearance

troubleshoots.symptom: prices look national, not your market

narrative.when_to_use: Use for REWE grocery tasks in Germany: offers of a market, building a pickup basket, finding the earliest pickup slot, turning recipes into a basket and placing the order after the person confirmed.
